entries.zh: 利钱；放债生息，计算利息
entries.en: usury; profit from lending — to put out money at interest (dar a logro)

entries.zh: 合算钱款；放贷本利合算
entries.en: usury; to reckon the money together, totalling principal and interest in lending at interest
usury; to lend money at interest (put money out on loan)
entries.notes: M 栏两处声调污损（T99），附语 'L pâng lay.' 难确解；放债生息之义据 H/L 三栏仍明确，按 T99 规则降为低置信

entries.zh: 向人叩算利钱；不损本金的收益
entries.en: interest gained without losing any of the principal; to reckon/collect interest money from a person
entries.notes: 西语 'sin per...' 为缩写，推断展开作 perder（不折损本金）；'叩' 字义待考，姑从 M 栏 cã 作向人索取解

entries.zh: 滚算；利上滚利（欠债不还则累算利钱）
entries.en: interest rolled onto a debt if it is not paid — compounding interest
entries.notes: L 栏短语有 [疑]（cobrala/sobre la），据 'deuda si no se paga' 与 車算＝滚算 义互证

entries.zh: 利钱；利息（本金所生之息）
entries.en: interest money; interest that does not multiply (simple, non-compounding interest)
entries.notes: M 栏首音节 bō 无汉字对应；L 栏 'q.no' 之 'no' 若为误读则单利义不立，待复查原件
M 栏一处声调污损（T99），尾注 'noaigan ana cia' 难确解（疑为例句）；利息之义据 H/L 明确

entries.zh: 肠虫；腹内寄生虫（蛔虫之类）
entries.en: intestinal worm; worm of the guts (roundworm)
entries.notes: M 栏一处声调污损（T99）；'面虫' 得名义（或谓虫斑见于面部）无从确证，释义从 L 栏 肠中之虫

entries.zh: 腰背；脊背部位（脢，或作膂）
entries.en: loins; lower back (also the meat of the loin)
entries.notes: 汉字 [疑:脢/膂] 待定；R 栏 'chham loc.' 似互见指引（参＝见某处）而非官话对音

entries.en: loin meat; meat of the back/loins
entries.notes: 同上条，'脢/膂' 之辨待复查原件

entries.zh: 灌入猪肠做成的香肠（西班牙腊肠）
entries.en: longaniza — sausage stuffed into pig intestine
entries.notes: M 栏 'Fumpôniǎ' 难按字确解；'xip/quip' 有 [疑]，据 H 栏 入豬腸仔 与 L 栏 longaniza 互证

entries.zh: 悉听上裁；任凭尊便（要做何事悉听裁定）
entries.en: whatever you wish done — as you please, at your discretion
entries.notes: '尚裁' 当读 '上裁'（M 栏 siăng 与闽南语 上 同音），与西语 whatever you wish 相合；此解依赖通假推断
L 栏 'à' 后文字有 [疑: ploser/plorar] 未定；H 栏第二字 [疑:板/枚]，据 M 栏 păn 取 板
